title: Foeniculum vulgare tincture for medicinal use
intro: Foeniculum vulgare tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the dried fruit of the fennel plant. It is commonly used in herbalism for its digestive and carminative properties. This preparation helps relieve bloating, gas, and indigestion by stimulating the production of digestive enzymes. It is also known to support respiratory health and may help alleviate coughs and bronchial congestion. Fennel tincture is often used in aromatherapy and as a natural remedy for women's health issues, such as menstrual cramps.
